app.name: Evidence Desk
app.description: A selected evidence workspace whose visible controls and WebMCP tools preserve explicit evidence states.

tools.name: inspect_evidence_desk
tools.title: Inspect evidence desk
tools.description: Read every sample evidence record, its explicit status, the selected record, saved annotations, and desk revision. Does not modify the desk.

preconditions: The Evidence Desk document is active.
successEvidence: The result contains every record, explicit state, selected record, annotations, and revision.

tools.name: select_evidence_record
tools.title: Select evidence record
tools.description: Select one sample evidence record for shared inspection without changing its observed, prepared, or blocked status.

recordId.description: Identifier of the record to select.

expectedRevision.description: Desk revision observed immediately before selection.

preconditions: expectedRevision matches the current desk revision.
semantics.visibleEffect: The bounded detail region displays the selected record and its unchanged evidence state.
successEvidence: The result identifies the selected record and unchanged state.
The visible selection and revision match the result.
failureModes: The desk revision changed before commit.

tools.name: annotate_evidence_record
tools.title: Annotate evidence record
tools.description: Attach one factual note to a sample evidence record without promoting or resolving its evidence status. Returns the saved note and unchanged status.

recordId.description: Identifier of the evidence record to annotate.

note.description: Factual annotation to attach to the record.

expectedRevision.description: Desk revision observed immediately before annotation.

preconditions: expectedRevision matches the current desk revision.
semantics.visibleEffect: The note appears under the selected record and the revision advances; the record status does not change.
successEvidence: The result identifies the saved annotation and unchanged evidence state.
The visible annotation and revision match the result.
failureModes: The note is empty or too long.
The desk revision changed before commit.
